rows.notLocal: Not downloaded yet. Folio can commit it once the file is on this computer.
rows.unreadable: Folio couldn't read it. Close it in other apps, then try again.
rows.required: Always in the commit: it goes with a settings change, which every commit records.
rows.metadata: Tags and settings: in every commit, but a change that belongs to a file you leave out waits for that file.
rows.listChanged: The list changed meanwhile, so the check boxes stay as they were. Check the list, then try again.

limit.leaveOut: That's the most you can leave out
limit.include: That's the most you can pick

tooMany.leaveOut: You can leave out up to {{count, number}} changes one by one. To commit only a few, turn off Include all changes, then check the ones you want.
tooMany.include: You can pick up to {{count, number}} changes one by one. To commit most of them, turn on Include all changes, then leave out the ones you don't want.

group.alwaysSome_one: {{count, number}} of them is always in the commit. The rest can't be committed yet.
group.alwaysSome_other: {{count, number}} of them are always in the commit. The rest can't be committed yet.
group.alwaysTip: Tag and settings changes go into every commit. A change that belongs to a file you leave out waits for that file.
group.committable: {{count, number}} of them can be committed now.
group.toggle: Space includes or leaves out every change in it.
group.mixed: Some of its changes are included. Space includes them all.
group.blocked: None of its changes can be committed yet.

menu.label: Actions for {{name}}
menu.committing: Wait until the commit is done

commit.label: Commit
commit.descriptionPlaceholder: Description (optional). Leave both empty and Folio writes a short summary.
commit.descriptionPlaceholderAi: Description (optional). Leave both empty and {{service}} writes them.
commit.written: Written by {{service}}. Change anything you like.

AiNetwork.title: {{service}} didn't answer
AiNetwork.text: Check your connection and try again. You can still commit: Folio writes a template message.

AiTimeout.title: {{service}} took too long
AiTimeout.text: Try again in a moment. You can still commit: Folio writes a template message.

AiRejected.title: {{service}} turned down the API key
AiRejected.text: Check the key in App settings → AI. You can still commit: Folio writes a template message.

AiRateLimited.title: {{service}} is busy right now
AiRateLimited.text: Try again in a minute. You can still commit: Folio writes a template message.

AiUnavailable.title: {{service}} isn't working right now
AiUnavailable.text: Try again later. You can still commit: Folio writes a template message.

AiBadResponse.title: {{service}}'s answer couldn't be used
AiBadResponse.text: Try again, or write the message yourself.

AiCredential.title: Folio couldn't read the API key
AiCredential.text: Windows Credential Manager didn't answer. Set the key again in App settings → AI.

unknown.title: {{service}} couldn't write a message
unknown.text: You can still commit: Folio writes a template message.

fallback.title: Committed with a template message
fallback.text: {{reason}}, so the message is “{{summary}}”. You can edit it until you sync.

failed.title: Couldn't commit
failed.WorkspaceChanged: The changes changed while you were committing. Check the list, then commit again.
failed.NothingToCommit: There's nothing to commit any more. Another change may have undone it.
failed.FileChanged: {{name}} kept changing while Folio read it. Save it and close it, then commit again.
failed.NotLocal: {{name}} isn't downloaded yet. Open it so it downloads, then commit again.
failed.InUse: Another app is using {{name}}. Close it there, then commit again. Your message and choices are kept.
failed.DiskFull: The disk is full. Free up some space, then commit again.
failed.ReadOnly: A newer version of Folio changed this library. Update Folio to commit.
failed.HistoryDamaged: Folio can't read this library's history. Your files are fine.
failed.Busy: Folio is rebuilding its search index. Commit again when it's done.

HistoryTooLarge.folder: The folder {{folder}} holds more files than Folio's history can keep. Move some files out of the folder, then commit again.
HistoryTooLarge.library: This library holds more files than Folio's history can keep. Move some files out of the library, then commit again.

block.busy: Folio is rebuilding its search index. You can commit when it's done.
block.readOnly: A newer version of Folio changed this library. Update Folio to commit.
block.damaged: Folio can't read this library's history, so you can't commit until it's fixed.

target.gone: That change isn't in the list anymore

empty.title: No changes
empty.text: Everything is committed. When you add, edit, move or delete files, the changes show up here.

emptyDiff.title: Nothing has changed since your last commit
emptyDiff.text: Changes to the files in your library show up in the list.

rebuilding.title: Rebuilding the search index.
rebuilding.text: You can commit when it's done.

readOnly.title: History is read-only.
readOnly.text: A newer version of Folio changed it. Update Folio to commit.

damaged.title: Folio can't read this library's history.
damaged.text: Your files are fine, but you can't commit until it's fixed.

notSynced.title: Not synced
notSynced.text: Cloud sync comes in a later version. Until then, commits stay on this computer.

firstCommit.text: Folio is saving the first version of your library: every text and Word file, and a record of everything else. You can keep working; changes show up here when it's done.
